remarks: Price Improvement. Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom ranch-style home, nestled in the sought after Cranbury neighborhood. This home features a bright and airy sunroom, perfect for relaxing with your morning coffee or enjoying a good book. The spacious two-car garage provides ample storage and convenience, while the partially finished basement provides additional living space, ideal for a home office, gym, or entertainment area.  Step outside to discover a large, beautifully landscaped yard, perfect for outdoor activities, gardening, or simply unwinding in your private oasis. With its welcoming layout, modern amenities, and prime location, this home is perfect for everyone alike. Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this house your home!
